name: data-protection
description: GDPR operations for controllers, law firms and DPOs, in four skills. gdpr-breach-72h-en runs a personal data breach through Art. 33-34: is it a breach, the risk factors from EDPB Guidelines 9/2022, notification to the supervisory authority without undue delay with the 72-hour outer limit counted from awareness, communication to individuals and its exemptions, and the internal breach register. gdpr-dpia-en decides whether a DPIA is required (Art. 35(3) cases, the national lists, the nine WP248 criteria) and drafts it to the Art. 35(7) minimum, up to the Art. 36 prior-consultation call. gdpr-dsar-en handles data subject requests under Art. 12 and 15-22: identity, the one-month limit and its extension, exemptions such as Art. 17(3), and a draft response. gdpr-ropa-dpa-en builds the Art. 30 records of processing and checks a processor contract against every Art. 28(3) stipulation. Every statutory reference is checked against the GDPR text and logged. Each skill ends in a draft for a person to approve; filing, sending, erasing and signing stay human. Small offline Python calculators compute deadlines and checklists; there are no connectors and no network calls of their own.
